note: Splunk 10.x compatibility test matrix. PREPARED, NOT RUN: every status is NOT_RUN until a disposable host runs it and the result file is attached. A version is promoted to `tested` in images.lock only when every applicable row for it is PASS. Source of the rows: docs/design/rc2/08-splunk-10x-compatibility.md section 8.5.

rows.test: start the pinned image on each claimed platform (including Apple Silicon emulation) and wait for ready
rows.pass: Splunk Web and management answer; /services/server/info version equals the pin (four-segment safe); KV store status ready

rows.test: start with SPLUNK_START_ARGS and SPLUNK_GENERAL_TERMS as the lab does
Bearer-token search through the strict client; search/v2/jobs/export with the application's queries; server/info
rows.pass: the staged diagnose passes all four stages; a search-only token still works

rows.test: every application template and the diagnose queries through spl_policy and a real search
rows.pass: identical result rows to the 10.2 baseline on the same data

rows.test: HTTPS HEC on 8088: health, one event, one batch; TLS 1.2/1.3 client succeeds; TLS 1.0/1.1 client fails
rows.pass: event found by search exactly once within 60 s

rows.test: install splunk_app/agentsec; indexes created; dashboards load; agentsec_telemetry writable and searchable
rows.pass: no errors in splunkd.log for the app

rows.test: stop, start, up --force-recreate, down then up
rows.pass: indexed events and configuration survive (named volumes)

rows.test: clone the volumes of a populated 10.2 instance and upgrade the COPY to 10.4.4, then to 10.6.1
rows.pass: events and KV data intact; KV migration completes; all rows above re-run; original volume untouched

rows.test: 10.6 with insufficient free disk; with no AVX; with postgresMigrateOnStartup=false
rows.pass: the installer's preflight fails first with a number; the documented option works

rows.test: management port 8089 and HEC bound to loopback only; default admin password not accepted
